stories.text: 🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: 49er Faith-Fool vs Ramosverse. Playoff odds with a win / loss: 49er Faith-Fool 74% / 51%, Ramosverse 19% / 6%.
🎯 TWO WINS: 49er Faith-Fool: 75% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 43% with none (now 66%).
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: Gibb it to Me Baby has 4 starters on bye this week (Collins, Olave, Likely and Purdy). Hope the bench is ready.
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Williams and Irving for Judkins and Collins back in Week 4 would have helped both Kyle Tucker and Gibb it to Me Baby.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 34%, with In My Fantasy Era next at 27%.
🎸 DEEP CUTS: Ramosverse is starting Douglas (10%) and Mitchell (14%) while Hall (96%) and Washington (95%) sit. % = rostered across ESPN.
🛒 WAIVER WIRE MVP: Ramosverse's pickups have put 266.82 pts into its starting lineup this season, led by Stroud (73.12 pts) and McLaughlin (66.00 pts).
🥊 Heavyweight bout: #1 Brock You Like a Hurricane (6–1) meets #2 Claremont In Yo Stace! (6–1).
🎲 The Mahomies is rolling with 2 kickers and 2 defenses. It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
🥶 Kirbo Crushers has dropped 7 straight. Can they snap it against TDsMaGee?
🪓🎤 Bye bye bye: Uriel's Upbeat Team has 2 starters on bye (Fairbairn and Likely) and 24% chop odds. The guillotine loves a short-handed lineup.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: Ruffing the Passer added George Holani (RB, projected 4.62 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 22% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
